description: Bornes de Recharge pour ELECTRA (IRVE) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Electra. Data on ELECTRA Electric Vehicle Charging Terminals. Context To supply the [National Directory of Charging Infrastructures for Electric Vehicles (IRVE)] daily and automatically ( Structure Follows the IRVE data schema. Coverage: Electra. The portal shows the English title as "Recharge Terminals for Electric Vehicles ELECTRA (IRVE)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Electra. Its keywords include vehicule, recharge, bornes-de-recharge, irve, bornes, geolocalisation. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
